title: Overlap card, photo fade
headline: C with the photo fading into white
lede: Option C with the header photo dissolving into the white panel, the looping animation, no Replay button and a Messages-style iMessage icon. It now defaults to the soft buttons with iMessage first and the new button text; the other colours and the WhatsApp-first order are still here to compare. The footer is dark gray.
summary: C's layout and animation sizes, with the photo fading into white like D and E, and the card still rising into the fade. Buttons read “Use on iMessage” and “Use on WhatsApp” (“iMessage” and “WhatsApp” on phones), above “Text your receipt and Divi will split it — no app to download.”
verdict: Soft buttons with iMessage first work best: the pale green suits the sage brand, the blue is a gentle second colour, and the sage headline stays the strongest colour. Keep the dark gray footer.
